intended_first_mode: offline retrospective analysis of authorized, de-identified data
prohibited_current_modes: live hospital feeds or silent-mode monitoring of real patients
display of individual scores to treating clinicians
diagnosis, triage, treatment, escalation, or other care decisions

gates.name: Research intended-use statement
gates.stop_condition: do not expand beyond synthetic-only work until the research scope is approved

gates.name: Data access and lawful basis
gates.accountable_role: principal investigator, data custodian, institutional legal/privacy lead
gates.stop_condition: do not receive or process local patient-level data before written authorization

gates.name: Anonymization and re-identification risk
gates.legal_reference: Uzbekistan Law ZRU-547 on Personal Data, including Articles 16 and 18 in the current consolidated text
gates.accountable_role: data protection lead and data custodian
gates.stop_condition: pseudonymization alone must not be treated as anonymization

gates.name: Ethics and research governance route
evidence_required: written determination of required review body
site and sponsor approvals where applicable
gates.stop_condition: no recruitment, prospective collection, or silent-mode evaluation before written determination and required approvals

gates.name: Cross-border transfer and hosting
evidence_required: written legal review of transfer conditions
gates.legal_reference: Uzbekistan Law ZRU-547 on Personal Data, including Article 15 on cross-border transfer in the current consolidated text
gates.accountable_role: data controller and institutional legal/privacy lead
gates.stop_condition: no transfer outside Uzbekistan is assumed permissible without a study-specific written determination

gates.name: Medical-software regulatory status
evidence_required: written response from competent Uzbekistan authority
scope triggers for registration and clinical evaluation
gates.legal_reference: Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 738, effective 2026-02-26
gates.authority_starting_point: Center for Pharmaceutical Product Safety / Committee on New Medical Technology
gates.stop_condition: do not claim exemption, device classification, or authorization based on this register

gates.name: Security and data lifecycle
gates.stop_condition: no real patient data until the host institution approves the environment

gates.name: Research protocol and statistical plan
gates.stop_condition: existing Set B must not be reused for threshold selection

gates.name: Clean-checkout reproducibility
gates.stop_condition: do not describe reconstructed-working-copy results as exact-source reproduction

gates.name: Clinical validation and authorization
gates.accountable_role: clinical sponsor, qualified reviewers, and competent authorities
gates.stop_condition: no patient-care use, clinical claims, or marketing
